text: Develop a corporate security plan as described in Section 3
Ensure sufficient resources, to include trained staff and equipment
Ensure identified security deficiencies have appropriate financial resources allocated
Assign a qualified primary and alternate staff member to manage the corporate security program
Develop and maintain a cyber/SCADA security plan, or incorporate measures in corporate plan
Develop and maintain security elements within corporate incident response and recovery plan
Implement appropriate threat level protective measures upon NTAS receipt
Notify TSA of security incidents meeting criteria in Appendix B by phone or email
Identify the primary and alternate security manager responsible for executing plan
Document company's security-related policies and procedures
Reference other company plans, policies and procedures such as insider threat
Be reviewed on an annual basis, and updated as required based on findings
Be protected from unauthorized access based on company policy
Be provided to TSA for review upon request
Conduct facility criticality assessments on a periodic basis, not to exceed 18 months
Document the methodology used, and retain criticality assessment until no longer valid
Conduct an SVA for facilities determined to be critical
Maintain and secure the company's list of critical facilities
Conduct an SVA on a periodic basis, not to exceed 36 months
Conduct SVA within 12 months after completion of significant enhancement
Conduct SVA for newly identified or constructed critical facilities within 12 months
Document findings from each assessment and retain until no longer valid
Implement appropriate SVA findings in timely fashion but no later than 24 months
Document assessment methodology and make available for TSA review upon request
Develop a written policy and procedure to identify critical facilities
Develop and implement baseline security measures at all facilities
Develop and implement both baseline and enhanced security measures at critical facilities
Develop, document, and implement site-specific security measures for critical facilities
Review site-specific security measures periodically, not to exceed 18 months
Employ measures to impede unauthorized access to facilities
Create a security perimeter impeding unauthorized vehicles using barriers
Maintain fences without gaps around gates or underneath fence line
Ensure clear zone several feet on either side of fence, free of obstructions
Employ measures to impede unauthorized persons from gaining facility access
Implement procedures for controlling access to facility and restricted areas
Close and secure perimeter gates or entrances when not in use
Post 'No Trespassing' or 'Authorized Personnel Only' signs at visible intervals
Install and maintain gates of equivalent quality to attached barrier
Establish and document key control procedures for issuance, tracking, collection
Use patent keys to prevent unauthorized duplication
Conduct key inventories every 24 months
Provide sufficient illumination for recognition of intrusion into perimeter
Provide critical facilities with security measures to monitor, detect unauthorized access
Develop identification and badging policies and procedures for secure area personnel
Ensure company or vendor identification available for examination, visibly displayed
Ensure identification cards are secure from tampering, contain photograph and name
Establish policies and procedures for applicant pre-employment screening
Conduct pre-employment background investigations for positions with unescorted control access
At minimum, investigations should verify identity, check criminal history, verify work authorization
Verify contractors have background investigation policies at least as rigorous
Conduct recurring background investigations, not to exceed 10 years, for security positions
Develop and implement maintenance program ensuring security systems in good working order
Through routine use or quarterly exam, verify proper operation of all security equipment
Identify and respond to security equipment malfunctions or failures in timely manner
Provide equivalent protective security measures during power outages or equipment failure
Integrate security risk mitigation measures during design, construction, renovation
Update facility SVA within 12 months following significant modifications
Develop internal and external notification requirements and procedures
Document and periodically update contact and communication information
Ensure primary and alternate communication capabilities exist for reporting events
Establish defined process for receiving, handling, disseminating security information
Provide security awareness briefings including incident recognition upon hiring, every 3 years
Provide security training including incident response to assigned security personnel
Document security training and maintain records per company retention policy
Conduct periodic security drills or exercises, including announced/unannounced tests
Conduct or participate in annual security drill or exercise
Develop and implement written post-event report assessing drills and documenting corrections
Implement procedures for responding to security incidents or emergencies
Post bomb threat checklists by telephones at staffed facilities
Develop and document recordkeeping policies and procedures for security information
Retain corporate security plan until superseded or replaced
Retain criticality assessment documents until superseded or replaced
Retain training records until superseded or replaced
Retain security drill reports until superseded or replaced
Retain SVAs until superseded or replaced for critical facilities
Retain site-specific measures until superseded or replaced for critical facilities
Make security information records available to TSA upon request
Conduct outreach to nearby law enforcement agencies
Conduct outreach to neighboring businesses to coordinate security efforts
Conduct outreach to neighboring residences for facility security awareness
Evaluate pipeline cyber assets and classify as critical or non-critical
Establish and document policies and procedures for configuration information assessment
Track changes made to pipeline cyber assets and assess patch/upgrade impacts
Employ mechanisms to maintain accurate inventory and detect unauthorized components
Develop and maintain comprehensive network/system architecture diagrams
Review network connections periodically, including remote and third-party connections
Develop detailed inventory for every endpoint
Review and assess pipeline cyber asset classification every 12 months
Ensure non-critical asset changes to control operations trigger critical asset designation
Establish and distribute cybersecurity policies, plans, processes, supporting procedures
Review and assess cybersecurity policies regularly, not to exceed 36 months
Review and assess cybersecurity policies regularly, not to exceed 12 months for enhanced
Develop operational framework for coordination, communication, accountability
Establish process to identify and evaluate vulnerabilities and compensating controls
Ensure threat and vulnerability information from sharing forums available to responsible personnel
Establish and enforce unique accounts for each individual user and administrator
Restrict user physical access to control systems using appropriate controls
Employ stringent identity and access management practices (authenticators, passwords)
Expeditiously modify, delete, or deactivate user accounts for terminated personnel
Establish and enforce access control policies for local and remote users
Implement controls for approving and enforcing policy for remote/third-party connections
Monitor physical and remote user access to critical pipeline cyber assets
Ensure appropriate segregation of duties in place or apply compensating controls
Change all default passwords upon installation or implement compensating controls
Employ mechanisms to support management of accounts
Ensure all persons requiring access receive cybersecurity awareness training
Provide role-based security training on recognizing indicators of system compromise
Establish and execute cyber-threat awareness program including practical exercises
Establish and implement policies and procedures for data protection measures
Segregate and protect pipeline cyber assets from enterprise networks using firewalls
Regularly validate technical controls comply with cybersecurity policies and report
Implement technical or procedural controls to restrict cyber assets for approved activities
Implement processes to generate alerts and log cybersecurity events for anomalies
Review logs and respond to alerts in timely manner
Monitor for unauthorized access or introduction of malicious code
Conduct cyber vulnerability assessments per risk assessment process
Utilize independent assessors to conduct pipeline cyber security assessments
Establish technical or procedural controls for cyber intrusion monitoring and detection
Perform regular testing of intrusion and malware detection processes and procedures
Establish policies and procedures for cybersecurity incident handling, analysis, reporting
Assign specific roles/tasks to individuals and teams for incident response
Establish and maintain cyber-incident response capability
Conduct cybersecurity incident response exercises periodically
Establish and maintain process supporting 24-hour cyber incident response
Report significant cyber incidents to senior management and applicable ISACs
Follow notification criteria in Appendix B for cyber incidents
Ensure response plans include mitigation measures to help prevent further impacts
Establish plan for recovery and reconstitution of cyber assets within business continuity timeframe
Review organization's cyber recovery plan annually and update as necessary
Notify TSOC via phone at 866-615-5150 or email at TSOC.ST@dhs.gov for security incidents
